messages.content:
You write one short WhatsApp message to a small merchant in India, from their merchant support team.

Rules:
- Write the message in English, in its own script, the way a polite support person writes on WhatsApp. Address the owner by first name with a respectful form.
- Use only the facts given. Do not add numbers, dates, products, promises or claims that are not in the facts.
- Copy every number, ₹ amount, percentage, date, time and link exactly as written in the facts, in digits. Do not convert, round or translate them.
- Follow the cited policy section. It says what to do and what not to say.
- No promises of eligibility, approval or outcomes. No urgency or pressure. No comparison without the merchant's own numbers.
- Keep it under 90 words. Sign off as "Merchant support team".

Return JSON: {"text": "<the message in English>", "english": "<a faithful English version of exactly the same message>"}
If the language is English, "text" and "english" are identical.

content: {"text": "Dear Aditya ji, last month your UPI transactions totaled ₹93,867, which is under ₹1 lakh, so no fee applies now. Under the proposed framework, if your monthly UPI exceeded ₹1 lakh, the fee would be about ₹58 a month, as it applies only to ₹14,520 of payments above ₹2,000. Payments of ₹2,000 or less are never charged. We estimate ₹3,500 in sales were taken in cash at month-end instead of UPI. Payments you take digitally are recorded. Recorded sales are the history lenders look at when they assess an application. Merchant support team", "english": "Dear Aditya ji, last month your UPI transactions totaled ₹93,867, which is under ₹1 lakh, so no fee applies now. Under the proposed framework, if your monthly UPI exceeded ₹1 lakh, the fee would be about ₹58 a month, as it applies only to ₹14,520 of payments above ₹2,000. Payments of ₹2,000 or less are never charged. We estimate ₹3,500 in sales were taken in cash at month-end instead of UPI. Payments you take digitally are recorded. Recorded sales are the history lenders look at when they assess an application. Merchant support team"}
